# Depth-guided bed/body-frame repair attempt (unapproved)

This experiment extends the prior bed preview without altering the 5k source
or any earlier preview. It uses separate bed and wooden-frame identities,
rendered residual detection, gradient-based splat attribution, conservative
optical-flow mask completion, cross-view observed RGB-D recovery, a local indoor
Depth Anything V2 small depth prior, and a geometry-gated RGB-D optimizer.

## Outcome

**No replacement 3D PLY was approved or generated by the new RGB-D optimizer.**
The wall fit is still 19.58% inliers against a 30% gate. The depth prior aligned
to clean observed pixels in only two of five training views under the 0.15
median-error gate: `frame_0145` (0.090) and `frame_0146` (0.089). The other
three failed (`frame_0135`: 0.268; `frame_0140`: 0.290;
`frame_0144`: 0.203). The default wall-completion fit therefore rejected the
prior for insufficient aligned views. A two-view *diagnostic only* fit supported
46.63% of generated-prior points but no real training or held-out wall views.
Its held-out wall inlier ratios were 2.45%, 3.43%, and 5.53%, with 90th-percentile
wall-distance errors of 4.64, 5.53, and 5.45 scene units respectively. The
generated wall is inconsistent with observed geometry. The optimizer correctly

The six missing bed/frame view masks remained incomplete after conservative
flow propagation; all failed a consistency check or lacked an adjacent source.
No mask was silently invented. Three training-view renders still contained a
large bed detection (88,537–120,120 pixels at 540px width). An additional
revealed-layer pass suppressed 2,006 source splats and attenuated 302, but the
held-out `frame_0141` RGB still shows a recognizable bed. Splitting 1,752
mixed splats into 7,008 smaller daughters suppressed 2,149 daughters; 3,999
had insufficient evidence, and held-out rendering still showed the bed. Both
candidate PLYs remain unapproved diagnostics.

Cross-view reprojection of *observed*, clean wall/floor RGB-D covered only
127/164,218 masked pixels in `frame_0134`, 0/144,831 in `frame_0141`, and
4/126,862 in `frame_0143` at 540px width. The result was similar at 270px,
so this is not a simple sampling-resolution issue. Most hidden background must
therefore be inferred rather than copied from other photos.

## Safety and validation

- `frame_0134`, `frame_0141`, and `frame_0143` were excluded from fitting and
  residual-mask training. Relative to the earlier revealed candidate, the
  second-pass PLY changed >16/255 RGB in 26.23%, 46.36%, and 46.69% of their
  target masks, versus 0.73%, 1.53%, and 1.91% outside the masks after resizing
  to the same resolution. This is not a visual acceptance test: bed residue
  remains plainly visible.
- The new split PLY has the original 190 properties and 128 semantic dimensions;
  all unrelated source records are byte-identical in the parsed vertex array.
  The second-pass candidate also preserves its schema, 128D vectors, and all
  source records outside the measured change set.
- The full CPU-safe suite passed 101 tests with one existing skip. CUDA stages
  were run independently on the Orin. `optimize_depth_guided_background.py`
  rejected the actual weak-wall report before creating an output folder.

| Stage | Time | Peak process RSS | Peak PyTorch GPU allocation |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Separate-mask flow proposals | 4.55 s | 543 MiB | — |
| Rendered residual SAM/DINO detection (3 views) | 29.66 s | 4,121 MiB | 2,216 MiB |
| Second-pass Gaussian attribution | 21.77 s | 3,922 MiB | 937 MiB |
| Mixed-splat split and attribution | 14.23 s | 3,898 MiB | 945 MiB |
| Observed RGB-D reprojection (540px) | 14.82 s | 2,146 MiB | 923 MiB |
| Depth-prior inference (2 views) | 13.09 s | 2,302 MiB | 790 MiB |
| Depth-prior inference (5 views) | 7.59 s | 2,273 MiB | 790 MiB |

On this unified-memory Jetson, process RSS and CUDA allocation are different
accounting views and must not be added as independent physical RAM.

- Completed-or-rejected instance-mask evidence:

- Separate rendered residual masks and reversible source attribution:
  `output/bed-ops/bed-rendered-residue-seg-v1/`,
  `output/bed-ops/bed-residue-attributed-v3/`
- Unapproved mixed-splat candidate and held-out RGB:
  `output/bed-ops/bed-mixed-split-v1/`,
  `output/bed-ops/bed-mixed-split-renders-v1/`
- Observed-only RGB-D evidence and inferred depth priors:
  `output/bed-ops/bed-crossview-observed-540-v1/`,
  `output/bed-ops/bed-depth-prior-v2/`
- Rejected wall fit and two-view diagnostic:
  `output/bed-ops/bed-completed-wall-fit-v1/`,
  `output/bed-ops/bed-completed-wall-two-view-diagnostic-v1/`

The next *data* improvement is a capture exposing the wall and floor behind
the bed. Without that, a stronger completion model could propose plausible
geometry, but the present views cannot verify it; the confidence gate must
remain in place.
